Two decisions, 2026-10-17. OWNER (relayed by the lead, recorded in 5aa1097dc): the Post a Job loading column draws 5 cards when the poster has past jobs and 4 otherwise, from the job-history read, or before it lands from what this device learned on its last visit. LEAD (recorded in bba7b6005): when the device has never asked (a new device, a cleared cache), draw the first-time 4, never an empty column. The robot always visits with a cold browser context, which is exactly that never-asked case, and poster-e2e has past jobs, so its column grows by the one Repost card (+122px); helper-e2e, with no posts, does not jump. Bounded: only this element (path) and only a growth of at most one entry card (122px measured + the 8px ROW_BUDGET = 130px) is covered, so any other /post-job jump is still a breach (byDesignCovers in scripts/check-loading-state-shape.mjs). Lead 2026-11-07 (Q2773, Builder 5 measured): the growth is all below the fold (loading frame and loaded frame identical above it; CI run 42302309191 screenshots), so under the owner's 09-19 ruling ("SKELETON FILLS THE SCREEN, GROWS BELOW") the cap that tracked one fixture's length is replaced by growsBelow: any growth of this element, never a shrink.

byDesignNote: NOT DEBT. These are suppressed because a decision was MADE, not because nobody has got to them. Unlike `allow`, an entry here that stops breaching is not a failure: a tab whose content happens to fit one screenful simply does not jump, and that is no evidence the ruling was abandoned. Every entry must carry a `ruling`. Do not add to this list to silence a breach — that is what `allow` is for, and `allow` is the one that shrinks.
